images.processing: BBBC010 channel w2 (brightfield; the BBBC010 page calls channel 1 brightfield, but in the files w2 is the brightfield and w1 the GFP image), 16-bit TIFF 696 x 520; linear contrast stretch from the 0.5th to the 99.5th percentile of the image (94 -> 0, 2909 -> 255), clipped, 8-bit PNG; no crop, no resize (scale 1). Overlays from the 15 per-worm ground-truth masks of this well (BBBC010_v1_foreground_eachworm.zip): outline = shapekit.contours.mask_to_contours, resampled to 100 points; landmarks = skeletonize -> order_skeleton -> resample_by_arclength(12) for 15 of 15 worms; only the largest 8-connected component of each mask is used, which removed stray pixels from B07_11 (1 px).
